pages.text: $(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)The import bus pulls items and fluids (and whatever else, given addons) from the inventory it's touching and pushes them into $(l:ae2_mechanics/import_export_storage)network storage$(/l).$(br2)For purposes of lag reduction, if the import bus has not imported something recently, it goes into a sort of "sleep

mode" where it operates slowly, and wakes up and accelerates to full speed (4 operations per second) when it successfully imports something.$(br2)They are $(l:ae2_mechanics/cable_subparts)cable subparts$(/l).

pages.title: Filtering
pages.text: By default the bus will import anything it has access to. Items inserted into its filter slots will act as a whitelist, only allowing those specific items to be imported.$(br2)Items and fluids can be dragged into the slots from JEI/REI even if you don't actually have any of that item.$(br2)Right-click with a fluid container (like a bucket or fluid tank) to set that fluid as
a filter instead of the bucket or tank item.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: The import bus supports the following $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)upgrades$(/l):$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Capacity Card$(/l) increases the amount of filter slots$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Acceleration Card$(/l) increases the amount of stuff moved per operation$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Fuzzy Card$(/l) lets the bus filter by damage level and/or ignore item NBT$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Inverter Card$(/l) switches the filter from a whitelist to a blacklist$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Redstone Card$(/l) adds redstone control, allowing active on
high signal, low signal, or once per pulse
